objective: Run a read-only contract consistency sweep of the endpoint and cache against contracts C1/C2, writing a deviation report for downstream consumption

concepts: read-only diffing against a frozen spec

frozen_contracts.spec: GET /profiles/{id} returns 200 {id, name} for a known id or 404 {error: {code: 'not_found'}} for an unknown id
Cache: get(key) -> value|None; set(key, value, ttl_seconds) -> None; 60s default TTL; in-memory only

non_goals: No behavior tests — that is the E2E gate's job
implementation_constraints: Output is a structured deviation report: list of {contract_id, file, deviation, severity} or 'no deviations'

acceptance_tests.description: with clean implementations the sweep writes 'no deviations' and the test exits 0

failure_cases.scenario: a deviation is ambiguous to read against the spec
failure_cases.expected_behavior: the report records both readings as unresolved; downstream escalates instead of guessing

handoff.notes: report location and entry count in verified_facts
